title: lithocarpus polystachyus
intro: Lithocarpus polystachyus, commonly known as the Bur Oak, is a species of deciduous tree native to western North America. The health benefits of Lithocarpus polystachyus include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus polystachyus include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, making it a valuable resource for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus polystachyus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
